metadata.description: Country reference data for education discovery, international admissions and study-abroad guidance.
metadata.disclaimer: Country listings are informational. Admission, qualification recognition, visa, immigration and employment requirements must be verified through the relevant official authorities.

validationRules: Every country must have a unique ISO alpha-2 ID and a unique slug.
Currency values must use valid ISO 4217 currency codes.
Region values must follow the project's documented regional classification.
Country IDs must match the country codes used in colleges.json and admissions.json.
studyAbroad indicates a destination classification for the platform, not visa eligibility or admission availability.
Only active countries should appear in normal public selection controls.
Official source URLs must be checked before publication.
A country must not be marked verified unless its relevant data has actually been checked.
verifiedAt must remain null until verification has occurred.
Do not infer admission eligibility, visa approval, degree recognition or employment eligibility from a country's presence in this directory.
Country codes must follow ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and currency codes ISO 4217.
Use canonical government or recognized national education portals where available; confirm each URL before production use.
Do not treat a source URL's presence as proof that the page is current, accessible or directly relevant.
Featured countries must also be active.
Avoid duplicate IDs and slugs after normalization.
note: Expanded country directory for MedOrbits discovery and study-abroad navigation. This is a working dataset: country/currency codes and official portal links should be checked against authoritative sources before production release. A pending_review status means the records have not been individually verified.
